messages.content: Mutual NDA between Acme Corp. and Globex Industries LLC effective 2026-02-15. Term 24 months. Governing law: Delaware. Litigation in Wilmington. Termination on material breach with 30 days notice and 15 days cure.

MSA between Cloudforge Inc. (vendor) and Beacon Financial Services (client) effective 2026-01-01. Initial term 36 months, auto-renews with 90 days notice. Massachusetts law. Indemnification capped at 2x annual fees. AAA arbitration in Boston.
